inlineSql: Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 AND A.AC_GR in( '19','22','23','21','02') ORDER BY C.AC_NAME

SELECT A.DESIGN_NO as DesignL,BOOK_NAME As BookNameL,B.PR_NAME As ProductL,A.ITM_SIZE as SizeL,A.KR_NAME As KrNameL,A.ITM_GWT As GrwtW,A.ITM_TOUCH As TouchR,A.ITM_WEST_PRC AS WestPrcR,A.LBR_PRC AS LbrPrcR,A.LBR_RATE As LbrRateR,A.DESIGN_IMG_ID As DesignIdL FROM (DESIGN_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.PR_CODE = B.PR_CODE) LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.PR_CODE = C.PR_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.IT_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.BOOK_NAME,A.DESIGN_NO,A.SR_NO

Select A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE FROM MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = B.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = B.VCH_SRNO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.TAG_NO = ' ? ' ? AND A.VCH_SRNO = ? AND B.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,A.VCH_SRNO,B.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN A.ITM_SIGN ='+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE - A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY B.VCH_DATE DESC

Select A.TAG_NO AS TagNoL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,A.IT_CODE as ItCodeL,C.DESIGN_NO AS DesignNoL,C.ITM_GWT AS GrWtW,C.ITM_NWT AS NetWtW,C.ITM_MRP as MrpR,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE From (MAIN_STOCK AS A LEFT JOIN BAR_DETL AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.TAG_NO = C.TAG_NO AND A.VCH_SRNO = C.VCH_SRNO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND C.EMP_ISU <> 'Y' GROUP BY A.TAG_NO,B.IT_NAME,A.IT_CODE,C.DESIGN_NO,C.ITM_GWT,C.ITM_NWT,C.ITM_MRP,C.VCH_SRNO,C.VCH_DATE HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN A.VCH_SRNO ELSE -A.VCH_SRNO END) > 0 ORDER BY A.TAG_NO,C.VCH_DATE DESC
